title: Home Oxygen Therapy Setup Record — Opening the Payment Period of a Delivered System
content:
# Setup Record — Home Oxygen Therapy

## Situation the rule governs

A Home Oxygen Therapy system that has been delivered while its oxygen record still shows the order as awaiting setup is recorded as set up on its setup day. Recording the setup moves the oxygen record from awaiting setup to an active rental and opens the payment period: the setup day is recorded as both the setup date and the first day of the payment period.

For a setup this rule governs, and only for such a setup, the eligibility check that counts is the most recent eligibility check on the coverage's eligibility history dated on or before the setup day, and oxygen is set up only when that check is within that coverage class's eligibility re-verification days before the setup day; every other setup remains under the base eligibility test of Home Oxygen Therapy.

## The tool: `record_oxygen_setup_e2e7878b`

**Capability.** Records that a home oxygen system awaiting setup has been set up, so that its payment period is open. One call moves the patient's oxygen record from awaiting setup to an active rental (status `rental_active`), names the coverage record the rental is billed to, writes the setup date as both the setup date and the first day of the payment period, and stores the serial number of the stationary unit now in use. Nothing else on the record changes.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_oxygen_setup_e2e7878b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `oxygen_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's home oxygen record, read from the oxygen record lookup | identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `coverage_id` | the reference number of the coverage record the rental is billed to, read from the coverage lookup | identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `setup_date` | the date the payment period of the system begins; stored unchanged as the setup date and as the payment-period start date | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date with no time part |
| `serial_number` | the serial number of the stationary unit exactly as it appears on the setup delivery in the patient's oxygen service history | verbatim: copied character for character with no change |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Oxygen record <`oxygen_holding_id`> set up: status `rental_active`, coverage <`coverage_id`>, setup date <`setup_date`>, payment period from <`setup_date`>, unit <`serial_number`>." Its presence means the record was updated; the oxygen record lookup then shows the same values.

## Effect on the records

| Before the call | After the call |
|---|---|
| oxygen record awaiting setup | oxygen record an active rental, with its setup date |
| no payment period open | payment period starting on the setup date |
| — | the coverage the rental is billed to, and the stationary unit's serial number |

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `setup_date` 2025-05-14 returns a line reading "... setup date 2025-05-14, payment period from 2025-05-14 ...". The oxygen record lookup then shows an active rental with setup date 2025-05-14.
